有了更先进的科技后，恒星基地还可以升级并用于产出舰船或者资源。

texts.en:
Now that we have begun exploring our neighboring stars, it might be time to extend our reach.

A Starbase can be built around stars in surveyed £system£ Systems to expand our borders, allowing us to claim new regions of space

With future technologies, Starbases can be upgraded to produce Ships or other resources.

To claim a System;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship
£dot_green£ Right-click a surveyed System
£dot_green£ Select [GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase
